titleEn: Bathroom Renovation Port Moody 2026: Real Costs, Neighborhoods & Trusted Contractors
titleZh: 滿地寶浴室翻新2026：真實費用、社區指南及信譽承包商
contentEn:
A bathroom renovation in Port Moody in 2026 costs $12,000 to $50,000 or more depending on scope. A standard refresh runs $12,000–$25,000, a full gut renovation $25,000–$50,000, and a luxury master bath upgrade $50,000+. Port Moody's hilly terrain, older Heritage Mountain homes built in the 1980s–1990s, newer Newport Village condos, and proximity to Metro Vancouver all influence what your project will cost and how long it will take.

What Does a Bathroom Renovation Cost in Port Moody in 2026?

Based on Reno Stars' project data across the Tri-Cities and Port Moody area, here are the realistic 2026 cost ranges:

  • Standard Refresh ($12,000–$25,000): New vanity, faucet, toilet, flooring, paint, and re-caulking. Keeps existing plumbing rough-ins. Typical timeline: 3–5 weeks.
  • Full Gut Renovation ($25,000–$50,000): Complete demolition to studs, new tile (floor and shower/tub area), curbless shower or freestanding tub, plumbing rough-in, new vanity, quartz countertop, premium fixtures, LED lighting, and heated flooring. Typical timeline: 5–9 weeks.
  • Luxury Master Bath Upgrade ($50,000+): High-end materials including natural stone tile, custom millwork, designer fixtures, body-jet systems, steam shower, and smart toilet. Typical timeline: 9–16 weeks.

Port Moody falls under the City of Coquitlam's planning jurisdiction for most residential developments, meaning renovation permits follow Coquitlam municipal guidelines. Heritage Mountain homes may have additional architectural guidelines depending on the strata council.

Port Moody Neighborhoods: Which Area Is Your Renovation In?

Port Moody's geography means renovation considerations vary significantly by neighbourhood:

  • Heritage Mountain: Single-family homes built primarily in the 1980s–1990s. These properties frequently have original bathroom finishes from the 1990s. Full gut renovations are common, and many owners are renovating a bathroom for the first time after 30 years. Structural issues are rare, but older electrical panels may need upgrading.
  • Newport Village: Condominium communities built from the 2000s onward. Condo bathroom renovations in Newport Village follow Port Moody strata council bylaws, governed by BC's Strata Property Act. Cosmetic and mid-scale renovations usually do not require strata approval; work that moves plumbing fixtures does.
  • Ioco (Murray Street area): A mixed newer and older residential development near Port Moody's historic town core. Renovations in this area may be subject to Heritage design guidelines for character homes.
  • North Shore (Barnet Highway corridor): Townhomes and row houses alongside newer condo developments. Townhouse renovations, regardless of scope, typically require strata approval — always review your strata bylaws before starting work.

How Long Does a Bathroom Renovation Take in Port Moody?

Timelines vary by project type and complexity. Based on Reno Stars' experience in Port Moody and the Tri-Cities:

  • Standard refresh: 3–5 weeks
  • Full gut renovation: 5–9 weeks
  • Luxury master bath: 9–16 weeks

The City of Coquitlam (which issues renovation permits for Port Moody residential properties) typically takes 2–4 weeks to process permit applications for standard bathroom alterations. Buildings constructed before 1990 require an asbestos assessment under WorkSafeBC rules before demolition — this affects most Heritage Mountain properties.

Commonly Asked Questions About Port Moody Bathroom Renovations

How much does a full bathroom renovation cost in Port Moody in 2026?

A full bathroom renovation in Port Moody in 2026 costs $25,000–$50,000 for a complete gut including new tile, curbless shower, vanity, quartz countertop, and plumbing updates. A standard cosmetic refresh costs $12,000–$25,000. A luxury master bath upgrade costs $50,000 or more. Heritage Mountain homeowners frequently face higher costs due to the age of existing mechanical systems.

Do I need a permit for a bathroom renovation in Port Moody?

The City of Coquitlam issues renovation permits for Port Moody residential properties. Cosmetic work such as replacing flooring, painting, and swapping fixtures does not require a permit. Moving any plumbing fixtures — including moving a toilet, shower, or vanity drain — requires a permit and inspections. A pre-1990 property requires a separate asbestos assessment before any demo work begins.

Can I do a bathroom renovation while living in my Port Moody home?

Yes. A standard refresh (3–5 weeks) can often be done with the family remaining in the home, provided one bathroom remains functional. For full gut renovations (5–9 weeks), most families choose to temporarily relocate because the only bathroom is out of service during demo and plumbing phases. Reno Stars coordinates schedules to minimize disruption for Port Moody homeowners.

What is the strata approval process for condo bathroom renovations in Port Moody?

Newport Village and other Port Moody condo renovations are governed by the strata council and BC's Strata Property Act. Cosmetic renovations generally proceed without strata approval. Any work that modifies plumbing, electrical, or structural elements requires a formal strata application. Reno Stars has experience working with Port Moody strata councils and can manage the approval process on your behalf.

Why choose a local Port Moody contractor for my bathroom renovation?

Port Moody's terrain and diverse housing stock — from 1980s Heritage Mountain homes to modern Newport Village condos — require a contractor who understands local conditions, municipal permit processes through Coquitlam, and strata requirements for condo buildings. Reno Stars has completed projects in Port Moody and across the Tri-Cities and can provide references specific to your neighbourhood and project type.

What are the current material costs for bathroom renovations in Metro Vancouver?

Material costs in 2026 for a mid-range bathroom renovation in Metro Vancouver include: porcelain or ceramic tile at $3–$12 per square foot installed, quartz countertops at $55–$120 per square foot installed, a quality vanity at $800–$3,500, and plumbing fixtures at $500–$2,500 per component. Supply chain conditions in 2025–2026 have stabilized compared to 2020–2022, though lead times for specialty items such as custom glass shower enclosures remain 4–8 weeks.

2026年，滿地寶（Port Moody）浴室翻新費用根據工程範圍從12,000至50,000加元以上不等。基本翻新12,000至25,000，全面拆修25,000至50,000，豪華主浴升級50,000以上。滿地寶丘陵地形、1980至1990年代建的Heritage Mountain老宅、全新的Newport Village公寓，以及毗鄰大溫哥華的地理位置，都會影響您工程的造價和工期。

2026年滿地寶浴室翻新多少錢？

根據聚星裝修在滿地寶及三聯市地區的項目數據，2026年的現實費用區間如下：

  • 基本翻新（12,000–25,000加元）：新洗臉盆、水龍頭、馬桶、地板刷新、牆面油漆及重新填縫。保留現有管道預埋。典型工期：3至5週。
  • 全面拆修（25,000–50,000加元）：完全拆除至結構層，新瓷磚（地板及淋浴/浴缸區）、無障礙淋浴間或獨立浴缸、管道預埋更新、新洗臉盆、石英石檯面、優質五金、LED照明及地暖。典型工期：5至9週。
  • 豪華主浴升級（50,000加元以上）：高端材料包括天然石材瓷磚、定製細木加工、設計師五金、按摩噴頭系統、蒸汽淋浴及智能馬桶。典型工期：9至16週。

滿地寶隸屬於高貴林市的規劃管轄範圍，大多數住宅翻新許可證遵循高貴林市指南。Heritage Mountain社區的住宅可能另有建築設計指南，視具體strata管委會而定。

滿地寶社區：您的翻新工程在哪個區域？

滿地寶的地形特點意味著各社區的翻新考量差異很大：

  • Heritage Mountain：主要建於1980至1990年代的獨立屋。這些住宅的浴室裝修通常是1990年代的原始標準，全面拆修情況常見。許多業主是首次翻新使用了30年的浴室。結構問題不多，但較老的配電箱可能需要升級。
  • Newport Village：2000年代起的公寓住宅小區。Newport Village的公寓浴室翻新遵循滿地寶strata管委會章程，由《BC省共管財產法》（Strata Property Act）管轄。美容及中等翻新通常無需strata管委會批准；移動衛生管道設備的工程則需要。
  • Ioco（Murray Street區）：靠近滿地寶歷史城核心的混合新舊住宅開發項目。此區域的翻新工程可能需要遵守滿地寶對特色住宅的Heritage考量指南。
  • 北岸（Barnet Highway走廊）：城市屋及聯排別墅，與更新的公寓開發項目相伴。城市屋翻新，不論工程範圍，通常需要strata批准——開工前務必查閱您所在strata的章程。

規劃滿地寶或周邊三聯市地區的裝修？獲取聚星裝修的免費、無義務報價，服務滿地寶、高貴林、高貴林港及整個大溫哥華地區。

滿地寶浴室翻新需要多長時間？

工期因項目類型和複雜程度而異。根據聚星裝修在滿地寶及三聯市的項目經驗：

  • 基本翻新：3至5週
  • 全面拆修：5至9週
  • 豪華主浴室：9至16週

高貴林市政府（為滿地寶住宅翻新頒發許可證）對標準浴室改建工程的許可證審批時間通常為2至4週。1990年以前建成的建築物在拆除前需要根據WorkSafeBC規定進行石棉評估，這對Heritage Mountain房產影響最大。

滿地寶浴室翻新常見問題

2026年滿地寶全面浴室翻新多少錢？

2026年，滿地寶全面浴室翻新（包括新瓷磚、無障礙淋浴間、洗臉盆、石英石檯面及管道更新）造價25,000至50,000加元。基本美容翻新造價12,000至25,000加元，豪華主浴室升級造價50,000加元以上。Heritage Mountain的業主由於現有機械系統年齡的問題，通常面臨較高的翻新費用。

滿地寶浴室工程需要許可證嗎？

為滿地寶住宅房產頒發裝修許可證的是高貴林市政府。美容工程如更換地板、油漆及更換五金無需許可證。移動任何衛生管道設備——包括移動馬桶、淋浴間或洗臉盆排水管——則需要許可證和檢查。1990年前的房產在拆除前需要單獨的石棉評估。

裝修期間可以繼續住在滿地寶的家嗎？

可以。基本翻新（3至5週）期間，家庭通常可以繼續居住，只要一間浴室保持可用即可。全面拆修（5至9週）期間，大多數家庭選擇暫時搬出，因為唯一可用的浴室在拆除和管道階段無法使用。聚星裝修會協調施工進度，盡量減少對滿地寶業主的干擾。

滿地寶公寓浴室翻新strata審批流程是什麼？

Newport Village及其他滿地寶公寓浴室翻新由strata管委會及BC省《strata財產法》管轄。美容翻新一般無需strata批准即可進行。任何涉及管道、電氣或結構元素的修改工程，都需要正式的strata申請。聚星裝修有與滿地寶strata管委會合作的經驗，可以代表業主管理審批流程。

為什麼選擇滿地寶本地承包商進行浴室翻新？

滿地寶的地形和多樣化的住宅類型——從1980年代的Heritage Mountain老宅到現代Newport Village公寓——需要一位熟悉當地條件、高貴林市（滿地寶住宅項目的許可證簽發機構）許可流程，以及公寓strata要求的承包商。聚星裝修已在滿地寶及三聯市完成多個項目，可以提供與您的社區和項目類型相關的参考案例。

大溫哥華地區浴室翻新材料費用目前是多少？

2026年，大溫哥華地區中等浴室翻新的材料費用包括：瓷磚每平方尺3至12加元（含安裝），石英石檯面每平方尺55至120加元（含安裝），優質洗臉盆800至3,500加元，以及管道五金每件500至2,500加元。2025至2026年的供應鏈狀況相比2020至2022年已趨於穩定，但定製玻璃淋浴間等特殊商品的交貨期仍為4至8週。
